# proof-agent

Independent verification of a git diff. The worker does not judge the diff. Copilot SDK does.

## Bootstrap (if missing)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AndreaGriffiths11/proof-agent.git /workspace/proof-agent
python3 -m venv /workspace/.venv-proof-agent
/workspace/.venv-proof-agent/bin/pip install -e /workspace/proof-agent
```

## Command

From the target repo:

```bash
export PATH="/workspace/.venv-proof-agent/bin:$PATH"
export PROOF_AGENT_USE_CLI_LOGIN=1
unset COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN
bash /workspace/proof-agent/scripts/verify.sh main | proof-agent-verify-copilot
```

Force below threshold:

```bash
bash /workspace/proof-agent/scripts/verify.sh main --force | proof-agent-verify-copilot
```

In CI, do not set `PROOF_AGENT_USE_CLI_LOGIN`. Pass `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`. Missing token fails closed.

## Rules

- Do not hand-write a Copilot prompt.
- Do not add self-assessment to the packet. verify.sh builds it from git only.
- Report Copilot's PASS, FAIL, or PARTIAL verbatim.
- On FAIL with auto-fixable issues, fix and re-run, max 3 attempts.
- Do not post GitHub comments without explicit approval.
- Do not invent verify-clean.sh. The sealed command is the pipe above.
